name: bhs-cs-books
description: The BHS CS books (bhsawesome/, one directory per book). The builder/ workspace is the generic book builder (@peterseibel/book-builder, published for the BJC build in bhs-cs-content); npm here also carries the push-content bin (@peterseibel/bhs-content) that mirrors build/out to the bhs-cs website's content overlay, and the deps of the screenshot/parity harness in scripts/.
